Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 13 s. 2024 JAN 23 2024 ATTY. JOSE MARIO C. BUNAG ATTY. GAY CHRISTINE C. CORTES-LOPEZ ATTY. AZAIRAH B. MORTEL BUNAG AND CORTES LAW OFFICE Suites a & B, 10th Floor, Strata 100 Building F. Ortigas, Jr. Road (formerly Emerald Avenue) Ortigas Center, Pasig City Dear Attys. Bufiag, Cortes-Lopez and Mortel: This has reference to your letter dated October 10, 2023 requesting the Department to review certain concerns arising from the requirements for barangay clearances by the barangays and other related matters in relation to your client, the Segovia Development Corporation. The issue herein stemmed from Sec Co Philippines, Inc. (Sec Co)'s renewal of its barangay business clearance for purposes of amending the address in Sec Co's Mayor's Permit — one of the requirements of Barangay Bel-Air is a Barangay Lessor's Permit or Barangay clearance from Barangay Bel-Air. Per representation, Segovia Development Corporation (SDC) is a real estate lessor with principal address at the Heart Building, 7641 Bagtikan St., Brgy. San Antonio, Makati City. The SDC owns a property in Unit 302, Heart Tower, Valero Street, Salcedo Village, Barangay Bel-Air, Makati City, which is currently a subject of lease agreement with Sec Co. On August 9, 2023, SDC received a letter from the Punong Barangay of Barangay Bel- Air informing the SDC that as it is required to secure a Mayor's Permit, the Corporation is obligated to apply for a barangay clearance from Barangay Bel-Air under the Revised Makati Revenue Code if it were to lease Unit 302. Thus, the following points for clarification are submitted: I. Should there be separate barangay clearance and business permit for each unit being leased? 2. Are the lessors required to secure multiple Locational Clearance? 3. What is the status of the City of Makati's Electronic Business One-Stop Shop (e-BOSS)? 4. Enforcement of the automatic approval or automatic extension Of license, permit, certification and authorization "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

5. Compliance of Barangay Bel-Air's Citizen Charter as prescribed in ARTA Memorandum Circular 2019-002 6. What is the basis for the computation of Barangay Business Clearance? As regards number 1, we agree that the advice by the Makati BPLO that there be separate barangay clearance and business permit secured for each unit being leased is contrary to ARTA, DILG and DTI Joint Memorandum Circular No. 01, series 2021. Items 8.2.3(a) and 9.3 thereof is explicit, thus: 8.2.3 LGUs are reminded of the following: a) Barangay clearances related to business permit applications shall be integrated and processed by the BPLO and such need not be secured separately in the barangays where the establishment is located. xxx 9.3 Single Application for Lease of Multiple Real Properties LGUs shall simplify the requirements relative to any permit or license to be issued for an applicant engaged in the business of leasing multiple real properties within the same city or municipality. Such applicant shall be required to file a single application only for all of the properties subject of the business and shall simply submit a list of all such properties, indicating the amount of income derived therein. There shall likewise be a single assessment of the taxes, fees or charges to be paid for all the properties. With respect to number 2, following the discussion in number 1, we affirm the view that LGUs shall not require applicants to get locational clearance during the renewal of the business permit since compliance with zoning regulations has already been established during the initial application for business permitl. As to the number 3 and 5 issues, we recommend to call the attention of the concemed officials of Makati City and inquire from their end the status of their: (1) e-BOSS, considering that LGUs are mandated to automate their BPLS or set up an e-BOSS not later than June 17, 2021 ; (2) Citizen's Charter. For number 4 issue, it may be prudent to coordinate with the ARTA and DTI for possible amendment of the subject JMC, to include a provision on Automatic approval or automatic extension of license, permit, certification and authorization as provided in Rule VIII of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of Rep. Act No. 11032 or the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Govemment Service Delivery Act of 2018. As regards the last issue, per representation of the letter-sender, Section 3A.02(1) of the Revised Revenue Code provides that lessors or sub-lessors of real estate shall pay the tax in accordance with the gross sales or receipts for the preceding calendar year. The basis for payment of taxes is different from the basis of paying barangay clearance. Barangay clearance fee js different from taxes. 1 Item ARTA, DILG and DTI Joint Memorandum Circular No. 01. series 2021

This opinion is being rendered based on the facts as narrated in the letter and without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you Very truly yours, BY H RITY OF THE SECRETARY: TTY NVI R R.
